Ties Sensei, Senpai and Kohai (characters from dialogue/milestone-6.json, roles only, no real names) to the Tower story. dojoLines: 1-2 short dojo-side lines per tier, White to Brown/Black; Sensei hints reused from story/mystery-ladder.json (approved for reuse). Kohai's role: the small new student who grows braver and helps, and asks the question that opens the reveal. reveal: 6 screens, plays at the dojo after the Brown/Black Gate scene (gate-scenes.json); it follows gate-scenes.json screen 35 ("They were my friend. Let's bring them home together.") and tells the story behind that line without repeating it. No blame, no guilt. Verses live only in faith/guardian-faith-overlay.json storyScreens (KJV, checked on bible-api.com 2026-10-26; KJV is a placeholder until Jay answers sign wording vs KJV). Nothing shipped is changed.

reveal.plays: At the dojo, right after the Brown/Black Gate scene.

screens.speaker: narrator
screens.text: Back at the dojo, Sensei holds the old lantern from the shelf.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: Long ago, I trained here with a friend. We climbed side by side.

screens.speaker: kohai
screens.text: Is your friend the one keeping the light safe?

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: Yes. On the storm night, my friend carried the light up to keep it safe.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: I lit this lantern every night, hoping they would come home.

screens.speaker: sensei
screens.text: I never stopped hoping. Now we hope together. Let's climb!
